assumptions: Cast times are estimates (about 1.0s per skill) scaled by Combat Speed; the client does not publish them.
Bosses are treated as immune to Stun, so Wave Blow (needs a Stunned target) and Raging Spell are not used, and Fracturing Blow gets no Impact-status bonus.
Dark Crush is used in the window opened by Impactful Crush, Spinning Strike, Ensnaring Mark or Marchutan's Wrath.
Undefeated Mantra is an always-on aura while equipped. Earth's Promise lowers the target's Damage Tolerance whenever you are attacking.
Gust Rampage needs a Staggered target and is not used.
Stigma specializations are not exposed by the API, so none are applied.
MP: 2,000 base plus gear and boards, regenerating 30 MP/s; Incandescent Blow is used while MP allows, otherwise Onslaught.
